name: Maelstrom
doc: Maelstrom (Edea's enemy attack, c0m100): the screen copied into VRAM (0x240, 0x100), a prim-model layout at the targets' average point (its kind-9 objects drawn with the screen copy), the screen warp around the targets (the warp mesh over their heads and feet, its vertices moved by a row of the lens table, drawn faded then textured by the screen copy), particles falling back to the average point, the sound; the action results at counter 80. Gravija 214's sibling. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag207_maelstrom.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and warp vertices in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Master
parts.doc: The screen copy (VRAM (0x240, 0x100) cleared, the next frame drawn there), the main task's start at the targets' average point, the sound; the action results, the battle textures restored; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Layout
parts.doc: The prim-model layout at the targets' average point (its objects of kind 9 drawn with the screen copy)

parts.title: Warp
parts.doc: The screen warp around the targets: the mesh over their heads and feet, its vertices moved by the lens table's row, drawn faded then textured by the screen copy

parts.title: Particles
parts.doc: Particles starting around the average point and falling back to it, each playing its flipbook

groups.label: Ticks
groups.doc: The master's and the main task's ticks

params.label: Sound
params.doc: At the main task's sound tick

params.label: Screen copy
params.doc: The master's tick of the screen copy; its first one starts the main task

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The main task's tick of the sound

params.label: Results
params.doc: The main task's last tick: the action results, the battle textures restored (it ends when that is done)

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Ticks
params.doc: The layout drawn on the main task's ticks below this

params.label: Depth
params.doc: Its depth offset

params.label: Texture scroll
params.doc: Its scrolling objects' texture scroll a tick (low 7 bits used)

params.label: Layout
params.doc: The prim-model layout played (its models' animation)

params.label: Start
params.doc: The main task's tick the warp starts

params.label: Ticks
params.doc: Its ticks

params.label: Grow
params.doc: Its box growing from nothing over its first ticks (at least 1)

params.label: Fade
params.doc: Its fade: a half sine over this many ticks (at least 1)

params.label: Lens step
params.doc: The lens row it uses goes from 16 down to 0, up to 31 and back, this many ticks a step (at least 1)

params.label: Least size
params.doc: The box's least width and height: this / the average point's depth

params.label: Head drop
params.doc: The targets' head points (and the average point's height): their height word minus this

params.label: Widening
params.doc: The box widened both ways at each point by (size + 0x100) x this / its depth

params.label: OT entry
params.doc: Drawn at the nearest point's depth / 4 + this

params.label: Mesh
params.doc: The warp mesh (241 vertices, 240 polygons: its setup copies it whole into a block of its size: an edited one keeps its vertices and its size (move vertices, change colours))

params.label: Lens table
params.doc: Each vertex's x and y scaled (4.12) by the row's value at its length / 32 (0x20 rows of 0x80)

params.label: Start
params.doc: The main task's tick the particles start

params.label: Ticks
params.doc: New particles on this many ticks

params.label: Count
params.doc: New particles a tick (0x40 alive at most)

params.label: Distance
params.doc: How far from the average point a particle starts: this + a random below the next (pulled back by 1/128 of it a tick, a tick)

params.label: Distance random
params.doc: (at least 1)

params.label: Life
params.doc: A particle's draws (its flipbook's frames)

params.label: Particle
params.doc: The sprite sequence of the particles (a flipbook: an edited one keeps as many frames)

not_editable.label: Object kinds
not_editable.doc: The layout objects' renderers, a character each ("00900901": '9' the module's prim set drawing the screen-copy polygons, '1' the engine's with the texture scroll, else the engine's)
